orgDesign.companyProfile: Public-cloud data and AI platform provider serving enterprise data leaders, AI application builders, platform operators, security teams, and FinOps teams.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Stream-aligned groups own data foundation, AI platform, cloud operations, and commercial ecosystem loops with shared review around production AI readiness, cost, security, and customer adoption.
designPrinciples: Keep governance close to data and AI runtime surfaces.
Keep AI evaluation, serving, and safety in one release loop.
Keep FinOps, observability, and capacity planning connected to workload operations.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups that mirror the product-brick domains.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
